name: West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou
description: West Lake is a freshwater lake on the western edge of Hangzhou, China, ringed on three sides by gentle green hills. Causeways, three artificial islands, pagodas, temples and pavilions dot its 6.4 square kilometres, and you can stroll or boat between them. Poets and painters have celebrated its views since the Tang dynasty, and its design influenced gardens across China, Japan and Korea.
